title: See inference and tool calls as node components inside a harness run
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `tool_loop` and backend `mock`. Fangore runs a tool-loop harness with one tool then a final answer. The console must treat inference and each tool call as node components under a harness parent — not an opaque blob — using the same kinds as recipe interiors. Complements `fangore_traversal_contract` and `fangore_insp_soft_vs_hard`. He walks product steps (tool_loop) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario. [^june-nc-harness]
implementation: `CliInstrumentor` verb `tool_loop` runs `ToolLoopHarness` on the stamped/tapped EventLog. The harness emits `turn_start`, `inference`, `tool_call`, and `tool_result` with `parent_node_id` / `component_id`. `node_components_for_harness` lists planned components; `traversal_from_events` recovers them after the run.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `harness_components.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
